subject: Confirming dedicated pool technical deep-dive — Dec 3
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara@ivypay.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:02:00Z
Subject: Recap + proposed next step: dedicated capacity deep-dive

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Discovery highlights: you’re planning to pilot Redwood for transaction enrichment across 12 regional queues, peak queries ~25k qps (burst), expected steady-state 3–5k qps, p95 latency target <= 120ms, average prompt length ~400 tokens with 2x caching opportunity on customer prefixes.
- Open items we flagged: representative traffic snapshot, any rate-limiting logic we should be aware of, and whether requests will include large embedding calls in the same path.

To validate sizing and lock a Dedicated GPU pool, let’s schedule a focused technical deep-dive explicitly for throughput/latency and a brief runbook review. Monica (cc) will lead the sizing portion.

Proposed 60-minute slots (all US/PST):
- Tue Dec 2 — 09:00–10:00 PST
- Wed Dec 3 — 13:00–14:00 PST
- Thu Dec 4 — 11:00–12:00 PST

Can you confirm which of these works for you and Mark? If none, send two alternatives and we’ll do our best to accommodate.

I attached a short CSV template where you can drop a 24–48 hour traffic sample (ivypay-traffic-snapshot.csv) — that will speed the sizing. We’ll also ask for a representative request payload before the meeting (example-payload.json).

Next to schedule: locking the dedicated sizing call, sharing a one-page pre-call checklist, and assigning an internal runbook reviewer for your security questions.

Thanks — talk soon,

Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Chen <sara@ivypay.com>

Cc: Mark Liu <mark@ivypay.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T18:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed next step: dedicated capacity deep-dive

Hi Michael / Monica —

Appreciate the clear notes, that matches our internal readout. We can provide a 48-hour traffic dump and a couple of representative request payloads. A few clarifications before the sizing call: 

- The 25k qps figure is a theoretical burst across our global front-ends; realistic sustained regional peaks are closer to 4k–6k qps for the Americas.
- We do apply soft rate limiting per customer, and there’s an orchestration layer that batches some requests (we’ll share the batching window).
- We want to confirm that Redwood’s KV/prefix caching will be evaluated in sizing since a lot of our flows reuse session context.

Of the proposed slots, Dec 3 at 13:00 PST works best for both me and Mark. If you can lock that, I’ll ask ops to drop the traffic CSV into your Drive link and share credentials for a short test payload (read-only).

Thanks —
Sara Chen
Head of Platform Integrations, IvyPay
sara@ivypay.com
+1 (212) 555-9044

Sara / Mark —

Great — thanks for confirming Dec 3 at 13:00 PST. A couple of items we’ll cover and requests to make the 60 minutes efficient: 

Agenda (60 min):
1) 10m — quick review of traffic snapshot and key traffic patterns (burst vs sustained)
2) 30m — sizing model: token throughput, KV cache expectations, batch sizing trade-offs, and p95 latency projections for proposed GPU pool
3) 15m — checklist for Dedicated: network egress, VPC peering questions, and data isolation considerations
4) 5m — next steps and mutual action items (runbook items + deliverables)

Pre-call asks (please upload to the Drive link or reply to this thread):
- 48h traffic CSV (timestamps, request type, token count, client_id) — sample file ivypay-traffic-snapshot.csv attached.
- 2 representative request payloads (one cold start, one cached flow) — we’ve included example-payload.json for formatting.
- Brief note on expected concurrency per client_id (helps sizing per-tenant capacity).

If you prefer we can also run a short load replay during the meeting — tell us which hour block in your sample best represents a peak window.

I’ll prepare a preliminary sizing worksheet and share it before the call so we can iterate.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
